veranderings.voor: nie een lang been nie maar
veranderings.na: nie een lang been nie, maar
veranderings.rede: A contrastive 'nie ... nie, maar' takes a comma before 'maar', which also makes the contrast easier to read.

veranderings.blok: Die ribbes om die hart en die longe
veranderings.rede: The rest of the lesson uses the full form 'hulle' as a possessive ('hulle lyf'), so this keeps it consistent and plain for Grade 5.
'aansit' usually means sit down at a table or switch on; 'vas is' says attached and matches the study text ('aan die lyf vas is').

veranderings.na: waaraan die agterste ledemate vas is
veranderings.rede: Same as for skouerblad: 'vas is' says attached clearly and matches the study text.
